name: Bol'shaja Medvedica
source:
A miracle beyond the polar circle. They say it's hard to find a place to call your own, but what if such a place was not uniquely yours? What if both of you were not willing to give it up? Big Dipper is a kinetic visual novel, available in both English and Russian, which tells a romantic story of the unusual circumstances that brought two lovers together one fateful New Year's Eve. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/984470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
超越极圈的奇迹。人们说很难找到一个属于自己的地方，但如果这样的地方不是你独有的怎么办？如果你们两个都不愿意放弃怎么办？《北斗七星》是一部动态视觉小说，有英语和俄语版本，讲述了一个浪漫的故事，讲述了两个恋人在一个命运攸关的除夕夜在不寻常的情况下走到一起的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/984470/]Steam[/url]]
